name: Victor Sanh

affiliations.role: Working group chair; lead author of T0

bio: Victor Sanh is a machine learning researcher who was part of the early Hugging Face team and has since moved to a startup building AI agents. They are a lead author of the T0 paper on multitask prompted training from the BigScience workshop and a co-author of DistilBERT.
known_for: Early Hugging Face Transformers library work
